***DM-only command***
Add a text trigger specified by `trigger_text` for a reaction specified by `emoji`.

The `emoji` can be one picked from Discord's emoji menu,
or generated by its name like `:emoji_name:`,

tl;dr most of the command usage is available in `?help` and all commands can be used from private message to the bot, but they'll be listed here too for convenience, along with a quick description of what the bot does
↓ What the bot does automatically ↓

- **scheduled messages**: main thing. The bot keeps messages to be sent once daily or once ever at specified times, to the specific channel. DMs add the messages.
- **clock**: at specified times (6 am, noon, 6 pm, 9 pm) there'll be a message in <#851552515345350657>, and messages older than 24h are deleted.
- **stocks**: every day at 6 am the bot will read new stock prices from Rob's spreadsheet
- **PC location tracking**: every time someone makes a message (except for OOC or any channels not for all players), unless they're skipped from tracking (DMs and bots are), the bot takes note of the channel, so later anyone can check where someone was last. If someone was inactive for 24h they're removed from the list.
- **reactions**: if someone makes a message in a tracked channel, and it contains a specific word, the bot will add an emoji reaction to it. DMs set those.
- **pins**: every time a message is pinned, that little "someone pinned a message to this channel" notification will be removed after 10 minutes
- **rollover**: every midnight the bot reloads its stuff, so errors don't accumulate. This does not take the bot offline.
- **automatic uptime**: if something in the code shits the bed and the bot goes down, it'll come back online within 5 minutes
↓ Commands for all server members ↓

- `?help`: displays command list with a tl;dr for each, `?help command-name` gives details for that command. Only commands you can use are visible and usable.
- `?stocks`: lets players deal with stocks as set up by Rob, on its own the command lists prices, `?stocks mine` shows the player's portfolio, `?stocks buy` and `?stocks sell` do what they sound like
- `?time`: displays current server time
- `?where` shows which IC channel someone was last active, you can give it an @-mention, or a full display name, or the beginning of the display name (`?where roy` should match me now for example)

All commands are usable by private message to the bot, or in any channel in the server, but not in any other server.
↓ Commands only for mods (and DMs) ↓

- `?ooc`: makes the bot drop a message directing people to ooc channels, for when they do too much ooc chatting in ic channels

- `?here`: only usable in an IC channel (private messages not allowed either), lists everyone who was last active in the current channel. You can use `?here ping` or `?here tag`, and the bot will ping everyone from that list.

`?reload (which)`

***Admin-only command***

Reload message files, specified by what you pass to it as `which` in the usage above:

- if `which` is any of "daily", "time", "hour" -> the daily messages (defined with just their time)
- if `which` is any of "one time", "onetime", "date" -> the one-time messages (defined by date and time)
- if `which` is "both" -> both daily and one-time messages
- if `which` is "clock" -> clock messages
- if `which` is "all" -> all three message files

ArcaniaBot in exactly 2k characters:
It's a bot we made, specifically for season 4, to handle some stuff automatically, and to provide some utilities for DMs, mods, and players.

What is it that DMs and mods get to do? Don't worry about it.
I'll just let you know that DMs prepared some things for the bot to announce at some points in time. Keep an eye for those.

Commands for the players are as follows:
`?help` - shows the list of commands. Kinda like this channel but more detailed and elsewhere. `?help commandname` will give details on that command.

`?time` - displays current local time for the game. All times in the game are affixed to the US/Pacific timezone. America/Los_Angeles for timezone nerds.

`?where` - shows in which IC channel someone was last active. Call it with the target's nickname (full or just beginning), or username, or mention - all these would work on me:
- ?where Roy
- ?where versil
- ?where <@!148682928434577408>
If someone was gone for more than a day, they won't show up here, neither will DMs and bots.

`?stocks` - lets you interact with the stocks of Empire City companies. By itself the command shows the stock prices.
`?stocks mine` shows how many you have for each company. 
`?stocks buy company_code stock_amount` and `?stocks sell company_code stock_amount` do what they sound like, for the specific `company_code` (3-5 letters) and `stock_amount`. Remember the transactions are public, and that **AB has no integration with Avrae or DND Beyond, so you need to update your money on your character sheet after you buy/sell stocks.** The bot will do the math for you.

Commands can be used in any channel and by private message, and currently have no cooldowns. I hope I won't have to add restrictions to either, but I will if needed. Remember that the `?help` command may give you more details. For things not covered there or here, or any observed errors, please let me know.

This may be edited or expanded if new commands get added during the season.

I will pin this after i post it.  If a player dies, give them the 'Spirit' role, and direct them to <#860203398771376198>  as their primary IC Channel.  They can talk to other dead there.

There is also 5 rooms that as DMs we will be able to read the history of, but players will not.  <#860203979526635552> for example.  When you are working on deals that other players would not hear or know about, or events that others wont be watching, yo can give a specific player access to the channel -making sure to set them to not be able to read history- and talk them through things there.  They are both OOC and IC channels, as you might be describing what is happening to them in character, or talking to a spirit about where they want to come back, in an IC manner.

This also gives us the DMs an opportunity that if we are 'dealing' with a problematic player, instead of hiding in Direct Messages, we can have the log of the conversation on the server.  If you want the player to be able to see the history, just create a channel under Limbo, and grant them access without removing history access.  The default for the channels there is DMs and bots and that's it, so you'd have to add as needed.)

Ferrah is a dramatic eladrin ringmaster with constantly-changing skin tone who manages the fair on coney island and other public services.
Prosser and Trapero are twin trickster fey in charge of the various goods that travel in and out of ferrytown. They are constantly quarreling with each other, but are also each other’s  fiercest defenders.
Pirrame is a small but fierce sprite who is in charge of any enforcement, tactics, and espionage done by the court. She carries a rapier the size of a toothpick, though it can still deal immense damage.
